name: Window List Tab Groups
description:
Adds Chrome-style tab groups to the Window List bottom bar.

Right-click a window to add it to a group. Click a group's colored label to collapse or expand it, drag the label to move the group, and right-click it to rename, recolor, ungroup or close the group. Drag a window onto a group to add it, or away from it to take it out.

Requires the Window List extension (window-list@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampax.github.com) to be enabled.
